summary: Explains required certificate properties for WinRM certificate auth (clientAuth EKU and a UPN otherName SAN) and gives an OpenSSL script to generate the key and self-signed cert.
questions: What properties does a WinRM client certificate need?
How do I generate a WinRM client certificate with OpenSSL?
What should the UPN be in a WinRM auth certificate?

answer_card.title: Generating a WinRM client certificate with OpenSSL
answer_card.answer_md:
The cert needs:
- **Extended Key Usage**: `clientAuth (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2)`
- **SAN** `otherName` for `userPrincipalName (1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.3)`, e.g. `$USERNAME@localhost`

```bash
USERNAME="local-user"
cat > openssl.conf << EOL
distinguished_name = req_distinguished_name
[req_distinguished_name]
[v3_req_client]
extendedKeyUsage = clientAuth
subjectAltName = otherName:1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.3;UTF8:${USERNAME}@localhost
EOL
openssl req -new -sha256 -subj "/CN=${USERNAME}" -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout cert.key -out cert.csr -config openssl.conf -reqexts v3_req_client
openssl x509 -req -in cert.csr -sha256 -out cert.pem -days 365 -extfile openssl.conf -extensions v3_req_client -key cert.key
```
